scope: Independent evidence and arithmetic for the existing confirmed 16-full-trip design. This record does not amend its authorities, select a calendar, approve funding or establish actual annual current-service production.

primary_source.title: Programma di Bacino, revisione 7.2, Allegato 3.4 - Scheda ambito: Meratese
primary_source.inspection: Complete relevant PDF pages extracted and visually inspected; page numbers below refer to PDF position, not a printed page label.

combined_reference.meaning: Sum of the two published PdB route production totals. Includes both peak and offpeak production and the named complete route scope. It is a planning production reference, not proof of currently financed, measured or freely transferable production.
precision_findings: D185 displayed components: 19144 + 39714 = 58858, while its published total is 58859; the source displays a 1 km discrepancy.
D184 displayed day-type production cells sum to 37297, while its published offpeak total is 37296; the source displays a 1 km discrepancy.
Retain published route totals for the inherited 111419 reference. Do not infer unrounded values or silently repair the primary document.

day_type_table_shared_by_d184_d185.limitations: The table supplies aggregate planning day types, not actual dated operations or a complete dated 2026 calendar. The 363 total must not be filled to 365 with invented dates. Six project pairs on historical route sheets do not establish 16 current Linea 8 full trips on any date.

existing_official_gtfs_calendar_evidence.limitation: This frozen winter feed can establish the dates it publishes; it does not certify the remaining months, actual operated service or a current annual calendar. The current-service PDF reconstruction explicitly does not infer annual service days: docs/PHASE2_CURRENT_SERVICE_STOP_TIMETABLE.md.

current_confirmed_design_arithmetic.mixed_day_type_formula: annual_commercial_km = sum(day_type_count * day_type_full_trip_count * complete_path_distance_m / 1000); add separately any changed paths, partial trips and noncommercial km

scenarios.basis: Inherited comparison assumption; original design grid calls it IDEALISED_5_DAY_52_WEEK, not a dated calendar
Sensitivity: apply current identical 16-trip day to the count of PdB ordinary project day types

remaining_information: A dated calendar and declared service year, with school/non-school periods, Saturdays, Sundays, holidays and exceptions.
Trip count and any distinct paths for each adopted day type; confirmation whether 16 identical full trips apply to each operating date.

Operator/Agency confirmation of actual D184/D185 annual contracted and operated commercial production and the amount available for reorganisation, including treatment of peak/school and external route tails.
Depot, positioning and other noncommercial km; vehicle/driver plans, full operating cost and financial coverage.
